riddles.text: I have 88 keys but cannot open a single door. What am I?
I have two hands but I have never clapped, and I scream every morning. What am I?
I have a head and a tail but no body. What am I?
I am full of holes, yet I still hold water. What am I?
I get shorter the longer I live. What am I?
I have a spine but no bones, and I am full of stories. What am I?
Feed me and I grow; give me a drink and I die. What am I?
I have one eye but cannot see a thing. What am I?
I go up exactly when the rain comes down. What am I?
I have a ring but no finger. What am I?
I am a kind of room with no doors and no windows. What am I?
I am yellow, I am curved, and I am the star of every cartoon slip. What am I?
I have a tongue but I have never said a word. What am I?
I must be cracked before I can be of any use. What am I?
I have lots of ears but cannot hear a thing. What am I?
The more of me you take, the more you leave behind. What am I?
I can fill a whole room but take up no space. What am I?
I have four legs but I have never walked anywhere. What am I?
I have plenty of bark but I have never bitten anyone. What am I?
I carry my house on my back and I am never in a hurry. What am I?
I am black and white and read all over. What am I?
I have teeth but have never bitten anyone, and I love opening doors. What am I?
I show you everything but never say a word. What am I?
I am full of hot air and I go bang if you poke me. What am I?
I am heavy, I love the sea floor, and I stop ships from drifting off. What am I?
I am very attractive and I stick to metal. What am I?
I am cold, I am clear, and I vanish in the sun. What am I?
I count down before I leave and I never need a runway. What am I?
